description: Search and query the Eurostat catalogue — EU economy, demography, trade, and NUTS regional data.
name: io.github.cyanheads/eurostat-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Public origin override for deployments behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy (e.g. https://mcp.example.com).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.
environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls.
environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.
environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools and lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.
environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE

environmentVariables.description: Directory DuckDB writes canvas spill files to. Must be writable by the server process. Defaults to a 'mcp-canvas' directory under the OS temp directory.
environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.
environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated.
environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
